stage2_context_review: The legacy thesis leaned on attacking absences/defensive profile; Slovenia scoring showed that context was insufficient to justify treating the strong No money as decisive.
note: BTTS No lost 2-1. Absolute No money nearly doubled, but its share fell 79.7% to 72.1% and price reopened 1.56 to 1.60. Research candidate: when absolute money rises but selected-side concentration erodes and price moves adversely, confidence may need a downgrade; test this across many cases before any rule change.
